title: CoopCycle coopcycle-web before 6.20.1 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows any courier to read…
description: CoopCycle coopcycle-web versions before 6.20.1 have a broken access control vulnerability that allows any courier user to read and modify all incident records. The flaw arises because incident operations only verify the ROLE_COURIER role without further authorization checks. Attackers can enumerate incident IDs and use the PUT /api/incidents/{id}/action endpoint to alter orders and tasks belonging to other stores, including repricing, canceling, or rescheduling them.
